deployment.az: not exposed to the function; Lambda chooses per environment

model.transform: LoRA merged fp32 (weights/merge_export.py), H512 Hadamard fold (weights/fold_hadamard.py --block 512)

conditions.interleaving: every arm in every round; arm order rotated by one per round

instrumentation_overhead.method: not re-measured in E3: every arm, ctl included, runs P1's instrumented entry (LKAI_PHASES=1). P1 measured the overhead at +0.46% cold first request.

s3_requests_source: computed: ceil(size / part_size); CRT does not report its request count

compute.method: median(arm) - median(ctl) within each CPU part both ran on, pooled by min(n); 95% bootstrap

hash.method: sha256 of the filled memfd, in-function, on separate E3_VERIFY=1 cold starts

host.cpu_part_source: /proc/cpuinfo 'CPU part' line, logged by the handler at init (engine.py _cpu_part)

status_check.method: status rule applied to the delta within the largest CPU part both arms ran on
